title: Metamorphosis of fractional instantons on a twisted $T^4$ with a double-trace deformation: a numerical study
summary: We use numerical minimization of the lattice action of trace-deformed Yang-Mills theory on $T^4$ with twisted boundary conditions to find the classical minimum action configurations of fractional topological charge. We vary the twists and ratios of torus periods to interpolate between different $R^{4-k} \times T^k$ geometries. This allows us to see how the corresponding minimum action saddle point configurations -- monopole-instantons ($k=1$), center vortices ($k=2$), and fractional instantons ($k=3,4$) -- morph into each other.
